report.summary: Patient P-D008 (41M, Medicaid via Lakeshore Community Health Plan, transport benefit included; home tract 17031400800, low-income area, 45.7% of households no vehicle) needs help with utilities and transport. Utilities: he is eligible for Lakeside Energy Assistance (open to everyone, mark likely_ok, reference ATKA2858F) plus income-based Neighborhood Energy Help (apply in person Mon/Wed) and the walk-in Shutoff Prevention Clinic (Tuesdays) for disconnection notices. Transport: eligible for Medicaid Ride Line (call number on card ≥2 business days ahead); Senior Shuttle West is not eligible (age 60+ only); Paratransit requires ADA certification with up to 21-day decision. Patient reports he drives an older car, but transit stops are plentiful near home (61 within 800m) if needed.
